      have cases₂ : ∀ i : Multiplicative (ZMod 2), i = 1 ∨ i = swap := by

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the Lean representation. Each compact crossing has one mark for its entire finite complex label. Each projection parameter has pointwise finite fibers and gives the inverse trace dot. The middle right mark carries 1 + τ, and the explicit addition of two complete left drawings gives the same evaluated map. The single-drawing obstruction uses the full shared planar labelling fiber at the fixed boundary. The shared compilation slot checked the exact proposition and verified both ordered crossing codes for arbitrary labels, including zero, and the addition scope around the two complete left drawings.
